aq10_assessments:technical_opinion:A pon: The score obtained falls within the average range of the general population, indicating a low probability of autism spectrum disorder in this screening. ias_assessments:technical_opinion:Alto r: High risk for the development of nutritional deficiencies and chronic diseases (diabetes, hypertension, heart problems). Requires prompt intervention.

m10_perfis_pareceres:reflection:O que si:
What it means: Risk behavior.
Profile: There is a very high chance of dirt and bacterial plaque building up on the teeth. The patient urgently needs cleaning guidance and preventive dental treatment.

What it means: Intermediate knowledge.
Profile: The patient has a good understanding but still follows some myths or makes mistakes in their cleaning routine. This increases the risk of developing a root canal problem, gum disease, or tooth decay.

What it means: Excellent oral care.

m11_perfis_pareceres:basic_data:Mais de: More than 25 points on the Rosenberg scale.
m11_perfis_pareceres:basic_data:Menos de: Less than 15 points on the Rosenberg scale.
m11_perfis_pareceres:reflection:Forte au: Strong self-confidence and security. Scores very close to 30 may indicate strong emotional stability but may also reflect a defensive stance or difficulty facing vulnerable points.
m11_perfis_pareceres:reflection:Indica f: Indicates excessive focus on flaws, frequent feelings of personal dissatisfaction, and less confidence in one's own abilities.
m11_perfis_pareceres:reflection:Represen: Represents the pattern of most of the population. The individual maintains a good relationship with themselves and recognizes their qualities and weaknesses realistically.

m12_perfis_pareceres:basic_data:Menos de: Less than 51 points on the IAS.
m12_perfis_pareceres:reflection:Alto ris: High risk of developing nutritional deficiencies and chronic diseases (diabetes, hypertension, heart problems). Requires prompt intervention.
m12_perfis_pareceres:reflection:Já possu: Already has some healthy habits but also overindulges or has serious gaps (excess sugar/sodium or lack of whole grains and fruits).
m12_perfis_pareceres:reflection:Padrão a: The dietary pattern meets the guidelines very well. It acts as a protective factor for your health and longevity.
m13_perfis_pareceres:basic_data:Menos de: Fewer than 6 clinical items in each block.
m13_perfis_pareceres:basic_data:Pelo men: At least 6 of the 9 items in Block I (1-9) marked as "Quite a bit" or "Very much".
At least 6 of the 9 items in Block II (10-18) marked as "Quite a bit" or "Very much".

m13_perfis_pareceres:reflection:Há indic: There is an indication of more inattention symptoms than expected for the age. Observation of behavior at home and at school and assessment by a qualified professional are recommended.

There is an indication of more hyperactivity and impulsivity symptoms than expected for the age. Observation of behavior in multiple settings and assessment by a qualified professional are recommended.

There is an indication of significant symptoms in both dimensions, suggesting a possible combined pattern. This is the presentation that most reinforces the need for a complete diagnostic investigation by a qualified professional.
m13_perfis_pareceres:reflection:Os compo: The reported behaviors are within expectations for the age, with no significant indications of ADHD symptoms in this screening. Continue routine developmental monitoring.

m14_perfis_pareceres:reflection:A pontua: The score reached the alert level for elevated ASD traits. Priority referral for specialized multidisciplinary assessment (pediatric neurologist or child psychiatrist and neuropsychologist) for formal diagnostic investigation is recommended. The AQ-10 does not replace clinical diagnosis.

The score obtained is within the range of the general population, indicating a low probability of autism spectrum disorder in this screening. However, the AQ-10 is only a screening tool: if clinical concerns persist on the part of parents or guardians, assessment by a qualified health professional is recommended.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Aplicável c: Applicable with minimal adjustments based on the more dominant/spastic body side.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Aplicável n: Applicable in full (upper limbs tend to be preserved and functional).
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Demonstraçã: Repeated physical demonstration and breakdown of instructions into simple steps.
Repeated physical demonstration; breakdown of instructions into simple steps.
Repeated physical demonstration; gradual withdrawal of verbal support.
Repeated physical demonstration; one extra practice attempt that is not scored.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Execução pa: Standard execution; ample visual demonstration and support via Brazilian Sign Language when available.
Standard execution; start with a clear visual stimulus (flag, light, gesture).
Standard execution; replace the auditory signal with a clear visual stimulus.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Exige avali: Requires prior individual assessment (walking with instrumental support).
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Flexão de b: Arm flexion; knee-supported version if needed.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Guia humano: Human guide or guide rope; tactile marking and clear auditory commands.
Human guide or guide-rope system; clear auditory command; tactile marking at the starting line.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Instrução v: Verbal and kinesthetic instruction; physical demonstration.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Linha de pa: Starting line with tactile marking using raised tape; clear auditory command.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Mediante su: With support, backrest, or mechanical trunk stabilization.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Movimento i: Movement identical to the standard; tactile marking and clear verbal command.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Padrão ou a: Standard or adapted when upper-limb functional capacity is present; otherwise, prioritize clinical functional assessment with physical therapy.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Percurso si: Winding course with manual propulsion or complete replacement by a wheelchair agility test.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Priorizar a: Prioritize joint clinical functional assessment with physical therapy.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Realizar pa: Perform the standard version when functional capacity and safety are present. Do not perform when lower-limb involvement makes the jump unsafe or unfeasible; in that case, consider an alternative lower-limb power test when applicable.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Realizar so: Perform only when functional capacity and safety are present. If not feasible, consider an alternative lower-limb power test.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Realizável: Feasible only with support and high postural tolerance.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Salto horiz: Horizontal jump from a bilateral base. Carefully assess joint feasibility if there is severe lower-limb involvement.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Shuttle run: 9.14 m shuttle run with two blocks.
m15_pcd_adaptacoes:instrucao:Substituir: Replace with rapid wheelchair propulsion over the 20 timed meters.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Adequação postural i: Inherent postural suitability: assess lower-limb joints before jumping; clear tests according to structural limitation.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Assegurar estímulos: Ensure clear visual stimuli and support via Brazilian Sign Language; check understanding of the rules.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Capacidades motoras: Motor capacities intact: clear sports based on profile; pay attention to fatigue and learning pace.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Complexidade inerent: Inherent complexity of the rules: simple instructions and prior demonstration for task comprehension.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Considerar espastici: Consider spasticity, coordination, and rule comprehension; adjust intensity and complexity.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Considerar soberanam: Give full consideration to the child/adolescent's personal preference and desire in the final choice of sport.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Cruzar o nível GMFCS: Cross-reference the GMFCS level with each suggested sport; respect contraindications based on motor pattern (e.g., jumping at GMFCS III+).
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Estrutura motora pre: Motor structure preserved: clear sports based on the neuromotor profile, with no postural barriers.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Fragmentar instruçõe: Break down instructions, demonstrate repeatedly, and allow an extra practice attempt; reduce rule complexity.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Funções motoras pres: Motor functions preserved: clear participation based on neuromotor profile; focus adjustments on the communication channel.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Orientar percurso de: Guide the wheelchair agility course and adapt commands to the comprehension level.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Priorizar provas de: Prioritize upper-limb tests and trunk stabilization; avoid vertical-impact tasks.
m15_pcd_funil:regra:Verificar necessidad: Check the need for a guide/auditory commands and tactile marking; prefer sports such as Goalball or Football 5-a-side.
m15_pcd_grupos:descricao:Cadeira de roda: Wheelchair as the primary or exclusive means of mobility. Tests adapted or replaced for upper limbs.
m15_pcd_grupos:descricao:Capacidades sen: Sensory and motor capacities structurally intact. Primary barrier in cognition and practical understanding of tasks.
m15_pcd_grupos:descricao:Classificação o: Mandatory prior classification using the GMFCS Scale (levels I to V) before defining any test.
m15_pcd_grupos:descricao:Criança anda/ca: The child walks independently or with light assistance (cane, brace), with structural involvement without centralized central neurological alteration.
m15_pcd_grupos:descricao:Estrutura motor: Overall motor structure preserved. Adjustments to verbal and kinesthetic instruction and spatial orientation. Classification from B1 (total blindness) to B3 (low vision).
m15_pcd_grupos:descricao:Funções motoras: Motor functions and spatial orientation preserved. Adaptations exclusively in communication channels (visual stimuli, Brazilian Sign Language).
m15_pcd_grupos:laudo:Aplicação obrigatór: Mandatory prior administration of the GMFCS Scale (I to V) + medical report.
m15_pcd_grupos:laudo:Diagnóstico clínico: Formal clinical diagnosis + severity classification. Specify amputation level if applicable.
Formal clinical diagnosis + medical report. Confirm use of a wheelchair as the primary means of mobility.
m15_pcd_grupos:laudo:Identificação preci: Precise identification of the degree of hearing loss (mild, moderate, severe, or profound) + audiological report.
m15_pcd_grupos:laudo:Mapeamento do nível: Mapping of visual acuity level (B1, B2, or B3) + ophthalmological report.
m15_pcd_grupos:laudo:Nível de funcioname: Level of adaptive functioning (mild, moderate, or severe) supported exclusively by an official psychological or pedagogical report.
m15_pcd_modalidades:descricao:Deslocamen: Oriented movement, agility, and reaction speed.
Movement, power, and intense use of upper limbs over the wheelchair.
m15_pcd_modalidades:descricao:Força de m: Upper-limb strength and central trunk stability determine success.
m15_pcd_modalidades:descricao:Potência d: Upper- and lower-limb power with trunk stability.
m15_pcd_modalidades:descricao:Precisão c: Precision with trunk stability; low demand for movement.
m15_pcd_modalidades:descricao:Velocidade: Lower-limb speed and power are crucial.
m3_cenarios:frequencia:Até o momento, nã: To date, no attendance or absence records have been identified for the student in the system during this period. The absence of data prevents an accurate assessment of school monitoring, making immediate verification with the school office or pedagogical team essential to regularize the records.
m3_cenarios:frequencia:Identificamos um: We identified a critical number of absences in this period, exceeding the days attended in class. This pattern of excessive absences raises a pedagogical alert, as it interrupts the teaching sequence and hinders the absorption of the content taught.
m3_cenarios:frequencia:O estudante demon: The student demonstrated excellent regularity and commitment to the school routine throughout this month. The low absentee rate reflects a participatory and engaged attitude toward the learning environment.
m3_cenarios:mensagem:Parabéns pelo incen: Congratulations on your encouragement and partnership. Consistent attendance has been the pillar of the good results achieved so far.
m3_cenarios:mensagem:Solicitamos que ent: We ask you to contact the school office to regularize the records. We have found that no attendance or absence entries have been made to date, which prevents proper monitoring of the student's routine.
m3_cenarios:mensagem:Solicitamos uma ate: We request special attention and a family dialogue to identify the reason for the absences. It is essential to restore the routine of attending school to avoid severe setbacks in the final assessment of this cycle.
m3_impactos:descricao:Cada ausência gera: Each absence results in the loss of key concepts, accumulating doubts for the following units. Excessive absences disrupt the student's routine, leading to demotivation and a sense of isolation from the class. Pending activities pile up and must be completed at home to meet the requirements of the school year.
m3_impactos:descricao:Quando presente, o: When present, the student follows explanations step by step, making it easier to carry out complex tasks. Daily interaction strengthens bonds with teachers and peers, developing emotional intelligence and teamwork. Less need for substitute tests or grade-recovery assignments due to missed deadlines.
m3_impactos:indicador:Continuidade Pedag: Pedagogical Continuity, Socialization and Assessment Pace
m3_impactos:indicador:Lacunas de Conteúd: Content Gaps, School Disengagement and Task Overload
m4_imc_config:description:O aluno aprese: The student shows an excellent body composition appropriate for their age group. This condition directly supports cardiovascular performance, allowing higher-intensity training with excellent physical recovery and a lower risk of injury.
m4_imc_config:description:O indicador ap: The indicator points to a slight excess of weight for the body structure. This condition puts more strain on the joints during impact training, but it can be quickly improved by increasing the frequency and intensity of sports activities.
m4_imc_config:description:O índice indic: The index indicates a risk factor for cardiovascular and joint health. A low-impact physical activity plan (such as swimming or brisk walking) is recommended, combined with nutritional monitoring to ensure the student's safety and well-being.
m4_imc_config:description:O índice sinal: The index signals the need for nutritional attention. A lack of lean mass or energy reserve may limit the student's muscle strength and endurance in long-duration activities, causing early fatigue.
m5_capacidades_config:health_status:A ca: The ability to move quickly and reaction time are below expectations for the age. In health terms, this indicates a neuromuscular system with slow responses to external stimuli and low cardiovascular efficiency in explosive efforts, causing early fatigue and shortness of breath in short runs.

The ability to change direction quickly is below expectations. The student has difficulty braking and readjusting the body with control. In health terms, lack of agility and coordination significantly increases the risk of falls, ankle sprains, and knee ligament injuries during abrupt movements.

The ability to overcome resistance and support one's own body is below expectations. In health terms, lack of muscle tone places direct overload on bones and ligaments and causes extreme fatigue in simple tasks, such as carrying a backpack or maintaining posture at the school desk.
m5_capacidades_config:health_status:A re: Abdominal endurance is below expectations. A weak core (the body's center of gravity) directly impairs posture, overloads the lumbar spine, and increases the risk of back pain and postural deviations in the medium term.
m5_capacidades_config:health_status:Dese: Exceptional physical performance. The student shows an impressive reaction speed and perfect control of the center of gravity when changing direction. Their proprioceptive system (the body's ability to recognize its own position) is highly effective, ensuring maximum protection against injuries.

Exceptional physical performance. The student demonstrates a very high capacity to generate muscle tension and power. The skeletal system is fully protected against impact injuries, and the muscles show excellent metabolic efficiency and recovery capacity.

Exceptional physical performance. The student has excellent lower-limb power and impeccable motor coordination. The musculoskeletal system is highly protected and prepared for high-intensity physical challenges.

Exceptional physical performance. The student has excellent muscular endurance in the central region of the body. This results in impeccable posture, very high movement efficiency, and maximum protection of the spine under any type of load or effort.

Exceptional physical performance. The student has a very short reaction time and impressive acceleration, reaching maximum speed with ease. The cardiorespiratory system and skeletal muscles show very high metabolic efficiency and perfect neuromuscular coordination.
m5_capacidades_config:health_status:Níve: Healthy level and within the recommended standard. The student shows good trunk support, which ensures body stability, improves balance, and protects the lower back against impacts generated by jumps and runs.

Healthy level and fully appropriate for the age group. The student demonstrates excellent body control, braking and changing direction safely and with stability. This agility protects the joints against overload and reflects a well-developed neuromuscular system.

Healthy level and fully appropriate for the age group. The student reacts quickly to stimuli and maintains excellent movement speed. This pattern reflects a strong heart, great respiratory capacity, and conditioned muscles, promoting excellent energy expenditure and vitality in daily life.

Healthy level and fully appropriate for the age. The student shows excellent muscle density and tone, safely sustaining impact movements. This strength acts as a protective shield for the joints, boosting metabolism and ensuring excellent posture.
m5_capacidades_config:health_status:O al: The student can run at a steady pace but has difficulty accelerating quickly at the start or changing pace abruptly. Cardiovascular health supports the effort, but the leg muscles waste excess energy due to poor fine coordination and stride power.

The student can change direction but loses balance or speed during the movement. There is a functional motor base, but the joints lack efficiency in transferring body weight from one side to the other smoothly, using more energy than necessary.

The student has a strength base but lacks muscular explosiveness. Physical performance fluctuates and uses more energy than necessary to perform jumps. The health structure is stable, but fatigue sets in quickly during circuits.

The student has basic abdominal strength but tires very quickly when trying to sustain the effort. This early fatigue causes them to compensate with other parts of the body, destabilizing the trunk during runs and games.

The student has functional strength for routine activities but fails or loses body alignment when exposed to slightly longer efforts. The health structure is stable, but the stabilizing muscles tire quickly, causing postural compensations during games.
m5_capacidades_config:health_status:O ín: The jump index is below expectations for the age group. This indicates low power and lack of activation of the leg muscles. In health terms, this compromises impact absorption and weakens the structure of the knee and ankle joints.
m5_capacidades_config:health_status:O ní: The level is healthy and adequate. The student shows a good neuromuscular response and can overcome gravity with ease. This condition protects the spine and absorbs impacts safely during games and runs.
m5_capacidades_config:recommendation:Inc: We encourage practicing traditional street games at home, such as tag, dodgeball, or zigzag circuits drawn on the floor.
We encourage playful strength activities at home, such as tug-of-war, climbing playground equipment (jungle gyms), or games involving carrying light objects.

The young person is not content to be merely a passive user of digital tools and modern world constructions; there is an intrinsic intellectual curiosity to understand the "how" and "why" behind technological and structural mechanisms. This inclination toward methodological precision provides a solid foundation for careers in software development or engineering, environments where logical rigor serves as the raw material for designing and building tomorrow's solutions.

m7_perfis_pareceres:reflection:O eixo ce: The central axis of this profile's development is entirely aligned with the human factor and its complex collective interactions. The student demonstrates a remarkable aptitude for active listening, the practice of empathy, and the verbal articulation of abstract ideas. Their mind is stimulated by analyzing social phenomena, human rights, and the narratives that shape our culture. Far from being merely a theoretical inclination, this profile reflects an intelligence oriented toward practical transformation and conflict mediation. The young person shows latent potential to exercise leadership in environments that demand ethical responsibility, whether defending legal causes, educating, promoting mental health, or communicating essential information to the community.
m7_perfis_pareceres:reflection:Observo n: I observe in the student a unique combination of inventive sensitivity and organic empathy. This profile moves away from strict, traditional scientism; instead, it finds motivation in applying creative solutions to challenges involving living beings and human expression. Their mind is guided by the need to discover new alternatives, to heal, to design, or to transform the environment. The strong presence of creativity in this macro-area indicates that the young person can think "outside the box" when facing complex health or visual communication problems, making them ideal for careers that require innovation in caring for life or developing new aesthetic concepts.

I observe in the student a cognitive structure essentially oriented toward efficiency, pragmatism, and systemic thinking. Their mind easily grasps the big picture of complex scenarios, ordering priorities and distributing resources with precision. Leadership, in this profile, is not merely a position of command but a natural ability to bring people together around a common goal. Their inclination to devise strategies and manage processes indicates a robust potential for making assertive decisions and mitigating risks in dynamic corporate and economic environments.
